Include the two extra buttons in addition to the existing controls.
Elderly users may not understand the remote; a simpler remote is needed.
Unclear which advanced LCD options to include; the scope of options to expose needs to be decided.
Ambiguity about responsible ownership for menu design and how UI and ID should coordinate responsibilities.
The User Interface Designer will design the LCD screen function menu.
The User Interface Designer will prepare a list of the functions to be shown on the screen/menu.
ID will design the layout of the LCD screen.
